story: 安娜把信交给艾莎。艾莎读信后收起信，两人离开。对话和叙述字幕使用中文；以怀疑的氛围表达，不能改变这些事件。

beats.description: 艾莎读过信后，把信收起来。

provenance.adaptation: Existing team-authored letter software fixture, renamed Anna/Elsa and translated into Chinese. Uses pinned MovieAgent reference images. Not the upstream film script, generated motion, or independent evaluation data.
